critique.evidence: Frame pacing is stable on tablet/mobile (~16.67 ms average, 16.8 ms worst) and has no recorded long frames; desktop is weaker at 20.73 ms average and 33.4 ms worst. However, every standard capture reports 0 active animations and 0 changed elements across only ~195 ms, so no launch, control, result, or state-transition motion was actually demonstrated. Reduced-motion matches the media query but still reports 1 active animation at every viewport, preventing proof that animation is fully suppressed.
critique.fix: Capture measured before/during/after frames for slider/toggle changes, LAUNCH EVENT feedback, and results updates over a longer interval, including durations and easing. Under prefers-reduced-motion, eliminate the remaining active animation and prove equivalent state changes occur without animated movement. Recheck desktop pacing to keep worst frames near the 16.7 ms budget.
